title: The matched q^7 coefficient selects the remaining third-order two-radius chart motion
scope: The regular matched path through K1727's isolated bounded symmetric two-radius equality seed after the K1738 and K1742 selections.

pre_flight.question: Re-derive the first coefficient after q^6 and determine without assuming its order whether it selects theta=x_3.
pre_flight.rederived_inputs: Use the K1727 algebraic seed, K1731 two-radius moment recurrence, K1738 leading velocity and K1742 centers r_3=-80/3 and x_2=eta_*; K1747 is not assumed.
pre_flight.problem_matched_gate: Extend the fixed-seed Fisher law only as far as needed, compose it with the exact two-radius recurrence, and reject any coefficient that is blind to theta.
pre_flight.anti_overclaim: A selected finite invariant jet does not establish a complete analytic branch, finite-strength ordering, remote-boundary exclusion or a global optimizer.

matched_coordinates.higher_invariants: y=h_10/u^(5/2), z=h_12/u^3 and w=h_14/u^(7/2) are not free: they are generated from M_0=M_1=1, M_2=3-u, M_3=u^(3/2)r+15-15u, S=(M_3-M_2)/(M_2-1), R=S-M_2 and M_n=SM_(n-1)-RM_(n-2), with x=h_8/u^2 determining u locally.

matched_composition.thirteen_halves_selection: The complete q^(13/2) coefficient is independent of delta=r_4 and theta=x_3, so it does not select the remaining third-order chart freedom.
matched_composition.coercivity: The delta and theta Hessian entries are exactly 1/60 and 1/2520, respectively.

selection_boundary.first_theta_selector: q^7 is the first matched coefficient that depends coercively on theta=x_3; q^(13/2) is blind.
selection_boundary.third_order: Together with r_3=-80/3, theta=theta_* gives two invariant conditions for the two third-order (p,a) chart coefficients because det d(r,x)/d(p,a) is nonzero at the seed.
selection_boundary.fourth_order: The same q^7 coefficient selects r_4=delta_* but remains independent of x_4. One fourth-order chart degree of freedom therefore remains.

post_flight.overclaim_check: Reject promotion from the q^7 jet to complete-branch existence, finite-strength optimality, whole-chart uniqueness or an all-seed lower bound.
post_flight.counterexample_seam: Arbitrary x_4 paths share the entire selected jet through q^7, so the calculation cannot identify a complete branch.
post_flight.mistyping_check: delta and theta multiply s^4 and s^3 directly; they are not factorial-normalized derivatives.
post_flight.reproducibility_seam: The exact certificate reconstructs the Hermite contractions and the two-radius moment recurrence in Q(u,sqrt(u)); the hostile probe rejects order, center and scope promotions.

scope_guard: This exact selector is local to regular bounded symmetric two-radius paths near the K1727 seed. It is not uniform at the u=q singular face, for moving or growing supports, at finite channel strength, or over remote branches, and it supplies no complete branch, global optimizer or source-owned physical conclusion.
